name: git-guard
description: Blocks git push unless the prompt asked for it, switches GitHub accounts from a dropdown, and shows branch state in the status line.

accountOrder.title: Account order
accountOrder.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins to list first in the panel, in this order. Others follow in gh order.

pushWords.title: Extra push words
pushWords.description: Comma-separated words, in any language, that count as asking for a push (added to "push"). Example: empuja, 推送.

noPushWords.title: Extra do-not-push phrases
noPushWords.description: Comma-separated phrases, in any language, that cancel a push request in the same prompt. Example: no empujes, 不要推送.

commitIdentity.title: Commit as the account you switch to
commitIdentity.description: When you switch account in the panel, also set this repo's git user.name and user.email to that account (GitHub noreply address). Off by default.
